caption: The drawing is a monochromatic depiction in shades of gray and black, showing the front facade of a structure with a simple gabled roof. The upper portion of the building is rendered with a stippled texture and includes a centered, rectangular window or door with a small ledge or overhang above it. Below this, the middle section of the building has a brick-like pattern, suggesting masonry construction. The lower portion contains three symmetrically placed arches supported by columns, creating an arcade. The background is blank, with no additional elements. Below the building, there are two horizontal ribbons; the top ribbon contains the year "1797" and the bottom ribbon reads "Mision San Juan Bautista" in hand-lettered text. The entire composition is centered on a plain, off-white background.
title: Mision San Juan Bautista
